title: eval-harness: introduce per-prompt quality gating and CI metric hooks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Prevent silent regressions introduced by model or prompt changes by adding per-prompt quality gates integrated into CI. This PR implements a per-prompt threshold system, a lightweight metrics exporter for CI hooks, and a workflow to fail CI on quality regressions while allowing a configurable 'warning' mode for non-blocking observation. Summary of changes: 1) new eval_harness/quality_gate.py: core gating logic with threshold config and per-prompt aggregation; 2) eval_harness/ci_hook.py: CI entrypoint that runs selected prompt-sets, computes metrics and emits a compact JSON artifact for pipeline consumption; 3) tests/fixtures/prompt_sets/*: added two canonical prompt-sets used by the gating CI job; 4) dashboards/quality_gates.md: operational runbook and how to interpret gating artifacts; 5) updates to CI config (.github/workflows/eval.yml) to add an optional gating job and artifact upload; 6) minor refactor to metrics/exporter.py to add per-prompt dimensions. Compatibility and rollout: default behavior is opt-in via repo-level gating config; we added a feature flag ENV EVAL_GATING_MODE={off,observe,fail} to control enforcement. Checklist: - [x] implement gating core - [x] CI hook emits JSON artifact - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs and runbook - [x] performance: run on a 50-prompt smoke set < 90s on CI runners Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4821 PM-221 Notes: avoids breaking changes to existing eval_harness API surfaces, exposes new config file schema (documented), and includes a migration note for teams that want automatic fail-on-regressions.
